ai_summary: Funding supports the operation and modernization of the National Violent Death Reporting System for collecting and analyzing data on violent deaths and suicides. Eligible applicants include U.S. state governments, territorial governments, and local government entities, with a requirement for statewide or territory-wide surveillance implementation.
ai_quote: CDC will support eligible state, territorial, and local government entities, or their bona fide agents, in operating and modernizing NVDRS.
